description: Remove EXIF, GPS location, XMP, IPTC, comments, PNG text chunks and embedded previews from a photo before sharing it. JPEG and PNG are cleaned losslessly (image data copied byte for byte, like the website); by default the rotation is kept as a tiny orientation-only EXIF and the ICC colour profile is kept. applyOrientation re-encodes JPEGs with the rotation baked into the pixels. WebP/AVIF/HEIC/TIFF are re-encoded without metadata. Output name <name>-clean.<ext>. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/exif-cleaner/

applyOrientation.description: Instead of keeping the Orientation tag, rotate the pixels (re-encodes JPEG at `quality`; PNG is unaffected). Default false.

image.description: The photo: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

keepIcc.description: Keep the ICC colour profile (no personal data; keeps colours right). Default true.

keepOrientation.description: Keep only the Orientation tag so the photo still shows the right way up. Default true.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

quality.description: JPEG/WebP/AVIF quality when re-encoding is needed. Default 92.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: image_exif_strip
title: Remove photo metadata (EXIF)
